items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Ben would say come on upstairs and play so Sonny could go home... Ben would say get on that cymbal, which Sonny had up there

ctx.x: I saw him in Kansas City, but I didn't go up to him. He came through at that theatre, the Tower Theatre, and I saw him playing there, and then when I went to see Duke, I talked to Ben -- we had another mutual friend -- we worked together so much after that. Anyway, Ben and I kept getting to be better friends and so forth, and Sonny was having a bad time, he was sick with something --
